💡 git-writer | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: A cross-platform note-taking application that uses Git for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS) • Git-backed note storage for version control and synchronization • Markdown note editing and rendering • Minimalistic user interface
📖 Summary: Git Writer is a minimalistic, cross-platform note-taking application that leverages Git repositories for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes across desktop and mobile devices. It aims to provide a seamless experience for managing notes across Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 glances | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time system and process monitoring across multiple platforms, with options for remote access and data export.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform system monitoring (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD) • Real-time monitoring of CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, sensors, etc. • Container monitoring (Docker, LXC) • Web interface for remote monitoring
📖 Summary: Glances is an open-source, cross-platform system monitoring tool written in Python. It provides real-time insights into CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, and container usage through a user-friendly dashboard. It supports remote monitoring via a web interface or API, and can export data to various formats or databases.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 luna | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, customizable, and self-hosted interface for aggregating and viewing multiple digital calendars from different sources.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted calendar aggregator • Supports CalDav, iCal, and Google Calendar protocols • Single web application for all calendars • User management • Infinitely customizable themes and fonts
📖 Summary: Luna is a self-hosted calendar aggregator and frontend application that consolidates calendars from various protocols like CalDav, iCal, and Google Calendar into a single, customizable web interface. It offers extensive theming options and user management, aiming to provide a unified and personalized calendar experience.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 ai-file-sorter | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically organize and rename files on a user's computer using AI, reducing clutter and improving file discoverability.
✨ Key Features: • Content-aware file organization and renaming • Supports local and remote LLMs • Preview-based workflows for user-controlled changes • Analyzes image content, document text, and media metadata
📖 Summary: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop application designed to intelligently organize and rename files using AI. It supports local and remote LLMs, analyzes various file types including images, documents, audio, and video, and offers a preview-based workflow for user-controlled changes, ensuring privacy by design.
